purpose: Prevent Skin Stage 1 from guessing CN/KR release state or future-page eligibility before an authoritative release-metadata source and matching rule are established in Skin Stage 4.

requiredBeforeAssignment: An authoritative or separately verified CN release source is established.
An authoritative or separately verified KR release source is established.
A deterministic skinId-to-release-record matching rule is validated on representative samples and then across the canonical population.
Missing or conflicting release evidence has an explicit unresolved state rather than guess-based completion.

deferredReleaseVocabulary.rule: These labels describe the planned Stage 4 decision space only. Stage 1-5 must not materialize any of them onto canonical skin records.

displayTarget.rule: Do not assign Hero-page/future-page/both/hidden consumer targeting until release metadata is validated. Consumer routing is downstream of Stage 4 release classification.

nonAuthorities: Hero release chronology without a validated skin-release relation

downstreamBoundary.stage3: May inventory/extract/map assets but must not classify release state from asset presence or filenames.
downstreamBoundary.stage4: Owns CN/KR release evidence, matching rules, Korean skin names and future-status classification.
downstreamBoundary.stage5: Future Skin page consumer may select records only from Stage 4 validated release classification.
downstreamBoundary.stage6: Hero consumer may reuse the canonical population independently of future-page eligibility.

completionRule: Stage 1-5 passes only when the 540-record canonical population remains unchanged, Stages 1-1 through 1-4 remain PASS, no prohibited release/display field is present in Stage 1 generated record datasets, and no future-skin subset is materialized.
